searchScope.description: What was actually searched (directories/files/packages) to reach a PASS verdict — e.g. 'src/ entire tree', not just the one file that happened to be cited.

searchMethod.description: The concrete method used to search (e.g. a grep pattern, a specific tool invocation) — not a prose summary of the conclusion.

candidateCount.description: How many candidate matches the search above turned up, before any were excluded as non-issues.

excludedCandidates.description: Why each candidate (if any) was excluded as not exploitable/not applicable — the reasoning that justifies a PASS despite candidates existing.
